thread:
Alice M: Heads up — planning a rolling change to the reserved GPU pool autoscale policy tonight 22:00 UTC for aurora-reserved-2. Switching from linear -> step-surge (smaller minscale, short burst windows). Primary deploy owner @Bob S, fallback @Carol Eng. Need smoke checks, rollback plan, and canary watchers.

Bob S: Ack. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4123 (policy + allocator patch). I'll kick the canary at 22:00 and watch util/latency.

Carol Eng: I'll be on-call 22:00–23:30 if Bob needs handoff. Any quota or ticketed CSR required?

Alice M: No external CSR. We do need to validate: 1) no >2s p95 gen latency regression on small samples, 2) no forced OOMs, 3) canary slice stays healthy for 15m. If any fail, abort and rollback to policy v3.7.

Dave SRE: Minimal checklist for abort: GPU mem >92% on canary for >3m, sustained queue>300ms for 5m, or node-level evictions. If any hit, we pause and run rollback. I'll be ready to cut traffic back.

Bob S: Smoke commands (local sim):
```sh
./tools/smoke.sh --pool aurora-reserved-2 --slice s-7 --qps 10 --duration 300
# outputs p50/p95/gpu_util
```
I will post results in this thread.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary window for aurora-reserved-2 at 2026-05-09T22:00:00Z (window 30m). Canary slice s-7 pinned.

Emily Prod: I'll run the golden prompt set and monitor model-quality diffs + token-level traces during the window. Rollback playbook ready. Rollback command: `kubectl apply -f policies/policy-v3.7.yaml --namespace=inference` + `orchestrator rollback aurora-reserved-2 --policy v3.7`.

Bob S: CR approved by @Carol Eng. Starting canary at 22:00. I will annotate the deploy with flag `feature.autoscale_step_surge=true` so we can toggle quickly.

Carol Eng: Nice — confirm how to toggle the flag?

Bob S: Toggle plan:
1) Feature flag toggle in control-plane UI -> quick toggle (propagates in ~30s).
2) If we need immediate safety off: `curl -XPOST $CONTROL_PLANE/flags/feature.autoscale_step_surge/disable` (requires infra-token).

Dave SRE: I'll set dashboard alerts: p95 latency + gpu_util + queued_requests. If any alert hits, I'll DM Bob and post here.

Alice M: Final ask — please paste the 15m smoke summary here when complete and the exact timestamp you toggled. Thanks.

Bob S: Will do. Starting in ~15m.

(22:02) Bob S: Canary started. feature.autoscale_step_surge=true toggled at 2026-05-09T22:02:12Z. Triggered on slice s-7.

(22:10) Bob S: Smoke pass so far (10m): p50 110ms, p95 680ms (baseline p95 650ms), gpu_util avg 63%, no OOMs. continuing to monitor.

(22:20) Emily Prod: Ran golden prompt set. Quality diffs: negligible (<=0.6% metric drift). No functional regressions in sample set.

(22:27) Dave SRE: Alerts clear. GPU mem peaked 74%. queued_requests steady under threshold.

(22:32) Bob S: 30m smoke summary: p95 700ms peak, avg gpu_util 61%, no evictions, canary healthy. I'm promoting step-surge policy to remaining slices in the pool in rolling fashion (1 slice every 6m). I'll post each promote timestamp.

(22:39) Bob S: Promoted s-9 at 2026-05-09T22:39:05Z. No issues observed after 6m.

(22:45) Carol Eng: Quick note — we should watch tail latencies on large context requests for next 2 hours. I'll keep an eye.

(23:02) Bob S: Promoted s-12 at 2026-05-09T23:02:10Z. One minor p95 blip to 820ms for 2m, reverted traffic spike by scaling down client burst; auto-healed. No further action.

(23:20) Alice M: Thanks team. We can consider this cutover successful pending overnight telemetry. Leaving this open for any late regressions; if nothing by 06:00 UTC we close.

(06:00 next day) Dave SRE: Overnight check — graphs look stable, no regressions. Closing post.

Bob S: Marking PR merged and policy rolled. Follow-up: will open a small tuning PR to tighten step windows next sprint.

Emily Prod: Great. Thanks all :tada:
